content.text: Splitting into two independent pieces: (1) cursor pagination in src/read-api.mjs, (2) configSchema validation in scripts/add-source.mjs. They touch disjoint files, so two workers in parallel, then one review of the combined diff.

input.command: git worktree add ../ws-cursor -b cursor && git worktree add ../ws-config -b config

input.prompt: Goal: cursor pagination on listJobs in src/read-api.mjs. Files: src/read-api.mjs, test/cursor.test.mjs. Done when: listJobs(db, clientId, {limit, cursor}) returns {items, nextCursor}, nextCursor null on last page, offset callers unchanged, tests added and npm test green.
Review the diff of src/read-api.mjs and scripts/add-source.mjs against these done-whens only: [cursor pagination ...] [configSchema validation ...]. Report findings by severity. No edits.

Goal: validate configSchema in scripts/add-source.mjs. Files: scripts/add-source.mjs, test/add-source-config.test.mjs. Done when: bad config or unknown source exits 1 with a message and writes nothing, valid config still registers, tests added and npm test green.
